description: This is an integration test class for the Fineract Feign client, testing JSON serialization/deserialization, error handling, authentication, and configuration settings in a Java FPIC environment.

classes.name: FineractFeignClientIntegrationTest
classes.description: Main test class for verifying Feign client interactions with Fineract API, including JSON handling, error processes, and config options.

classes.name: FineractFeignClientIntegrationTest.TestApi
classes.description: Internal interface defining API endpoints for test interactions, annotated with Feign @RequestLine.

classes.name: FineractFeignClientIntegrationTest.TestRequest
classes.description: Data class representing request payloads with 'name' and 'date' fields.

classes.name: FineractFeignClientIntegrationTest.TestResponse
classes.description: Data class representing response payloads with 'id', 'message', and 'timestamp' fields.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes WireMock server and configures the Feign client before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Stops the WireMock server after each test.

methods.name: testJsonEncoding
methods.description: Tests JSON encoding by sending a POST request with a LocalDate and verifying parsed LocalDateTime.

methods.name: testJsonDecoding
methods.description: Tests JSON decoding by issuing GET request and verifying the response fields.

methods.name: testJava8DateTimeSerialization
methods.description: Verifies correct serialization of LocalDate and LocalDateTime in requests and responses.

methods.name: testErrorDecoder
methods.description: Checks handling of 404 error responses, ensuring FeignException is thrown.

methods.name: testErrorDecoderWithServerError
methods.description: Checks handling of 500 error responses, ensuring proper exception is thrown.

methods.name: testConnectionTimeToLiveConfiguration
methods.description: Validates configuration with connection TTL and test API call.

methods.name: testBasicAuthentication
methods.description: Verifies that Basic Authentication header is correctly set in requests.

methods.name: testNullValueHandling
methods.description: Tests handling of null values in request payloads and response deserialization.
